intent: Write JUnit 5 + AssertJ (Mockito / StepVerifier where reactive) tests for TelemetryLedgerRepository, asserting only against ast_hints. Unit: Context Telemetry Event Ledger. Outbound repository port, append-only: no update/delete methods. append stores the revision (unique recordId+revisionNumber; duplicate errors). findLatest returns the highest revision of a record (empty if none). findRevisions returns all revisions in revisionNumber order (audit trail). findHistory returns revisions by device and metric with deviceTimestamp in [from,to] ordered by deviceTimestamp.

methods.signature: Flux<EventRevision> findHistory(String deviceId, TelemetrySample.MetricType metricType, Instant from, Instant to)
